text: Been coming for two years. Always great service and great work!! The dentist has a great touch. And it is a very well run office. Couldn’t be happier with my dentist here in Bangkok.

I am writing this review with a huge, confident smile! My experience at this clinic was nothing short of exceptional from the moment I walked in.

A Welcoming and Spotless Environment:
The clinic is absolutely immaculate. The reception area is modern and comfortable, and this high standard of cleanliness is evident throughout the entire practice. It’s clear that patient health and safety are their top priority, which immediately put me at ease.

Comprehensive and Professional Care:
I came in for a combination of treatments: a teeth filling, a deep clean, and teeth whitening. Dr. Nara is phenomenal. She is incredibly knowledgeable and professional, but also has a very calming and reassuring manner. She took the time to thoroughly explain each procedure, why it was necessary, and what I could expect. Her recommendation for this treatment plan was clearly tailored to my specific needs, and I felt 100% confident in her expertise.

Clear Communication Every Step of the Way:
The communication throughout my entire visit was flawless. From the friendly front desk staff to the dental assistant and Dr.Nara herself , everyone ensured I was informed and comfortable at every stage. This transparency completely eliminated any anxiety.

Absolutely Stunning Results & Incredible Value:
The results have completely transformed my smile. The filling was seamless, the deep clean left my mouth feeling incredibly fresh and healthy, and the whitening results are better than I ever imagined—bright and perfectly natural-looking. Considering the level of care, the state-of-the-art facility, and these life-changing results, the service represents exceptional value for money. You are truly getting top-tier dental care that is worth every penny.

If you're looking for a dental clinic that makes you feel welcomed, cared for, and leaves you with a healthy, beautiful smile, look no further. I am so grateful for the recommendation and the incredible work.
